svg.title: SPATM token-level text model detail
svg.desc: The prompt "a ⟨i⟩ nurse" is tokenized to IDs, looked up to embeddings; the placeholder embedding v_i passes through the trainable MLP adaptive mapping with norm-preserving projection, receiving the concept embedding v_nurse as a side input, and the mapped v_i^c replaces v_i before the frozen text encoder produces the output embeddings.
